caption:
Your team has four phones. Only one of them rings when a lead calls.

Most shops route the main line to a single cell number, usually the owner's or the front desk. If that person is driving, on a roof, or in a meeting, the call drops to voicemail and the lead moves to the next name on Google.

Fix it this week:
1. Open your phone system settings (carrier app, VoIP dashboard, or your CRM's calling feature)
2. Build a ring group and add every team member's cell number
3. Set it to simultaneous ring so every phone rings together at once
4. Route to voicemail after 4 rings, with an automated text-back as the backup

Whoever answers first keeps the lead. Nobody else has to find out until it's booked.
